# Bibliotecas do PS4 no núcleo / PS4 libraries in the core

**pt_BR.** Catálogo de cada biblioteca do sistema do PS4 que o `ps4_core` implementa: em que arquivo, quantas funções, quais são de verdade e quais são stubs offline (só devolvem um valor fixo para o jogo seguir sem PSN/rede), e quais jogos usam cada uma. Gerado a partir das tabelas `RuntimeExport` e dos resolvers por NID (`port/src/*.c`), do `import_names.inc` e dos `LIB_FUNCTION` da GPU (`port/gpu/shadps4/core/libraries`). As colunas TLG/GR2/ISS vêm do `port/out/link.json` de cada port (os imports de sistema que o jogo pede de fato). Para regenerar: `tools/list_exports.py -o docs/LIBRARIES.md`.

**English.** Catalogue of every PS4 system library the core implements: file(s), function count, real implementations vs offline stubs (return a fixed value so the game proceeds without PSN/network), and which games exercise each one. Built from the `RuntimeExport` tables and NID-keyed resolvers, `import_names.inc` and the GPU `LIB_FUNCTION` registrations. Game columns come from each port's `port/out/link.json`. "real"/"stub" is a heuristic on the function body. Regenerate with `tools/list_exports.py -o docs/LIBRARIES.md`.

Game import lists / listas de imports: TLG `link.json` 2026-10-13, GR2 `link.json` 2026-10-13, ISS `link.json` 2026-10-13; game files at `origin/main`.

## Cobertura por jogo / Coverage per game

Who answers each system import of the game, in `runtime_resolve` order: core runtime, then the game's own `runtime_<slug>*.c`, then the GPU layer. "missing" resolves to nothing (the loader binds a trap/zero stub).

"Another game's file": the import is answered by a `runtime_<other slug>*.c` the port carries (e.g. inFAMOUS using GR2's files). Those functions are shared in practice and are the first candidates to move into the core.
